name: 10 — Performance: 50 Users (Direct Path)
description: Performance test with 50 concurrent users, 3 messages each (150 total requests). Uses 'mock' profile with NO app assigned — requests bypass Temporal and go direct to mock LLM. Tests gateway concurrency handling without worker overhead. Expected latency: ~300-500ms.
test_result_ai_analysis:
✅ Grade: A+

📊 Result: 50/50 users passed (100%)
⏱️ Latency: 320ms average
🔧 Path: Direct (no Temporal) — bypasses AppFlow workflows
👷 Workers: 0 used (direct mock provider)

🔍 Findings:
• Linear scaling: ~6ms added latency per concurrent user
• No failures, no timeouts
• Database connections stable (68-70)
• Redis ops minimal (18-24 ops/sec)
• Gateway handled 50 concurrent users comfortably

💡 Recommendation: Test scales well. Run Test 11 (200 users) to test higher load on direct path.
